rules.title: Quick Divisibility Rules
rules.description: Here are some tricks to quickly check if a number can be divided evenly:

by3.label: Divisible by 3
by3.rule: If the sum of its digits is divisible by 3

by9.label: Divisible by 9
by9.rule: If the sum of its digits is divisible by 9

by6.label: Divisible by 6
by6.rule: If it's divisible by both 2 and 3

orderOfOperations.title: Order of Operations
orderOfOperations.description: When you have multiple operations in one problem, follow this order: Parentheses, Exponents, Multiplication/Division (left to right), Addition/Subtraction (left to right). This is called PEMDAS or BODMAS.

tip.title: Important Tip
tip.description: Always use parentheses when you want to change the order of operations. For example, if you want to add first, write (3 + 4) × 2 = 14.

conclusion.title: 🎉 Congratulations!
conclusion.message: You've mastered the four basic operations! These skills form the foundation of all mathematics. Keep practicing to build speed and accuracy!
